# WAF and Cost Figure Semantics

## Qualitative WAF

The five pillars are Security, Reliability, Performance Efficiency, Cost Optimization and Operational Excellence.
Use the accepted pillar status, assessment, evidence and recommendations. Status text must remain understandable
without color. The upstream numeric 0-10 scale, example thresholds and synthetic scores are not vNext contracts and
must not be reconstructed from prose.

An aligned design is not deployed compliance, a restore-test pass or a performance measurement. Preserve
not-applicable, concern and blocker states; never hide a missing assessment by drawing a decorative full score.

## Cost Breakdown

- Every amount comes from the accepted cost estimate, with currency, monthly cadence, quantity and price provenance.
- Show priced rows separately from unpriced items. Unknown retail meters, partial/capped queries and missing usage
  are not zero cost. Reuse the managed pricing contract rather than querying through a diagram workflow.
- A displayed total is the accepted arithmetic over priced rows, not an estimate invented from service icons.
- Resource groupings must not mix currencies, time windows or reserved/consumption assumptions without accepted
  normalization.
- Stable row order and explicit labels are more useful than decoration; keep small/zero values legible.

## Uncertainty and Projections

Lower/base/upper amounts and confidence come from accepted uncertainty fields, including their basis. A range is
not a statistical confidence interval unless accepted data actually establishes that interpretation.

The supported runtime provides breakdown and uncertainty bars, not arbitrary donuts, trend projections or future
savings forecasts. Projection guidance from upstream is reference-only: it would require accepted time points,
usage/scaling assumptions, comparable currency/cadence and a registered renderer. Do not extrapolate from a single
monthly total or draw made-up savings.

As-built spend additionally needs scoped observed cost evidence; design prices are not actual invoices.

## Compliance Charts

The upstream gap/percentage charts are not an active renderer. They would require defined controls, denominator,
scope, observation/freshness, findings and a typed producer. Policy-map design dispositions do not establish live
compliance, certification or a percentage. Report an unsupported figure rather than computing a synthetic score.

## Inspection

Check labels, units, totals, unpriced treatment, ranges and source references against the same accepted objects used
by tables/prose. Report unreadable labels, clipping, absent formats and unavailable visual inspection explicitly.
